title: YouTube Shorts
description: Uploads meant to be classified as Shorts (square or vertical, up to 3 minutes), checked against YouTube's recommended upload encoding settings. Most encoding rules are recommendations, so they warn.

sources.title: YouTube Help: Understand three-minute YouTube Shorts
YouTube Help: Recommended upload encoding settings

notes: Wider-than-square or longer-than-3-minute uploads are not rejected; YouTube treats them as regular videos instead of Shorts. That is why aspect and duration are errors here.
YouTube recommends '2 consecutive B frames'. This profile does not require B-frames; `svqa fix` encodes without them so it can also honour 'no edit lists' without shifting audio sync.
YouTube's recommended GOP is half the frame rate. That is checked as info only, because YouTube re-encodes every upload.
The -14 LUFS reference for YouTube's loudness normalisation is widely measured by the community, not documented by YouTube.

container.edit_list.note: YouTube: 'No Edit Lists (or the video might not get processed correctly)'.

video.aspect.note: Shorts must be square or vertical.

video.keyint.note: YouTube: 'GOP of half the frame rate'.

audio.hiss.note: Observed 2026-10: a heuristic calibrated on game-trailer mixes, not a platform rule; see docs/checks.md#audiohiss.
